g.text: > Use the widget debug icons to open tool input/output, CSP activity, widget state, and JSON-RPC for each result.
Open the **Connect** tab in the left sidebar (labelled **Servers** in some builds). Click **Add server**.
* **HTTP**: Paste a URL ending in `/mcp`. The web app accepts **HTTPS** URLs only. Terminal, Desktop, and Docker accept **HTTP** o
r **HTTPS**; from Docker, use `host.docker.internal` for servers on your machine. Add a bearer token or use the [OAuth Debugger](h
* **STDIO** (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker): Paste a command such as `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything`. In Docker t
he command runs inside the container. Not available in the web app. See [Hosted App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md).
Each **Connected** server is available in the Playground, Tools, Prompts, and Resources. Connect more from the **Connect** tab any
> You should see your server show **Connected** with a green dot in the **Connect** tab, and its tools should appear in the Playgr
